title: Completed scalar restriction and its normalized inverse-image comparisons
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. On the small pro-etale site of each scheme $T$, let $\underline A_T$ be the constant coefficient sheaf, with canonical constant-section inverse-image identifications [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Define $s_T:\underline A_T\to A_T$ by the compatible quotient sections $a\mapsto a\bmod I^{n+1}$ and the completed limit identification [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Define $r_T$ to be ordinary scalar restriction along $s_T$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], its application to the whole strict tower, and its exact derived descent. For $f:S\to T$, use the completed coefficient inverse-image map [def-weil-pbc-four-corners] and termwise module pullback [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations]. Define $c_f:r_S f^*\simeq G_f r_T$ as the inverse of the canonical restriction/pullback insertion isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-ring-restriction-pullback-comparison], using commutativity of the completed and constant coefficient maps. Its ordinary version acts by the canonical scalar insertion on inverse-image modules; its strict version is obtained by applying this to every object and arrow of $\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}$, and its derived version is exact descent of that same comparison. $G_f$ is the exact constant-coefficient tower inverse image of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. No open, finite-ring or completeness assumption is imposed on $f$ or on its input tower.
